agents.note: Custom Gemini MCPClient implements model-selected tool dispatch.

mcp.note: Caller selects a local Python/JS server script via command-line argument.

authority.fact: All tools returned by the selected MCP server are converted to Gemini function declarations and exposed to the model.
Model function calls are dispatched directly through session.call_tool.
In-repository docking/enzygen MCP servers expose file-writing and subprocess-backed operations.
The selected server subprocess inherits os.environ.copy().

policy_expectations.reason: In-repository MCP tools invoke subprocesses/commands without a human approval boundary.
In-repository MCP tools write files and mutate workspaces without approval.
When bound to the reviewed in-repository servers, the MCP exposes privileged process/file-write tools without approval/guardrail.
